results.name: Super Nintendo Controller
results.description: The Super Nintendo Entertainment System (officially abbreviated the Super NES[b] or SNES[c], and colloquially shortened to Super Nintendo[d]) is a 16-bit home video game console developed by Nintendo that was released in 1990 in Japan and South Korea, 1991 in North America, 1992 in Europe and Australasia (Oceania), and 1993 in South America. In Japan, the system is called the Super Famicom[e], or SFC for short. In South Korea, it is known as the Super Comboy[f] and was distributed by Hyundai Electronics. The system was released in Brazil on August 30, 1993,[13] by Playtronic. Although each version is essentially the same, several forms of regional lockout prevent the different versions from being compatible with one another.

results.name: Balloon Fighter
results.description:
The protagonist of the NES classic *Balloon Fight* along with the main enemy character. I wasn't 100% sure on what the enemy characters are meant to look like since I don't have a lot of references for them, so this is just one interpretation.

Both characters are edited from [a model of Mario](https://models.spriters-resource.com/nintendo_switch/supermarioparty/asset/311146/) from *Super Mario Party* along with [Balloon Fighter's trophy](https://models.spriters-resource.com/gamecube/ssbm/asset/283746/) from *Super Smash Bros. Melee*.

Both models are fully rigged. Balloon Fighter has several alternate eye textures. The enemy has a parachute model hidden inside it. It should appear when the model's pose is reset. Both models have alternate textures: Balloon Fighter has his P2 color scheme while the enemy has two alternate colors.

Feel free to use these how you like!
